run_boost_shared_ptr_tests: run the doctest suite that validates boost shared_ptr conversion and null handling behavior
test_shared_ptr_derived_to_base: test that shared_ptr derived types can be converted to shared_ptr base types
test_shared_ptr_null_identity: test that null and identity functions return None for null shared_ptr values
test_shared_ptr_factory_types: test the factory function returns correct Y or YY types based on input value
test_shared_ptr_store_get_release: test storing, retrieving, counting, and releasing shared_ptr instances via store get and release
